install.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config clang cmake libhwloc-dev libudev-dev libssl-dev rustup && rustup toolchain install 1.91.1 --component rustfmt,clippy && rustup default 1.91.1 && curl -fsSL "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o /tmp/helm.tar.gz && echo "97dbeb971be4ac4b27e3839976d9564c0fb35c6f3b1da89dd1e292d236af4096  /tmp/helm.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c - && sudo tar -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=1 -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz linux-amd64/helm && rm -f /tmp/helm.tar.gz && cargo fetch
